meta.name: Predict and prevent service failures with Claude, ClickUp, and WhatsApp alerts

name: AI Predictive Failure & Incident Prevention Engine

parameters.content:
## AI Predictive Failure & Incident Prevention Engine

Runs on a schedule, builds a risk profile for every service from historical incidents, deployment history, metric trends, error-log volume, and code-change activity, detects recurring patterns (e.g. 'fails within a day of a Friday deploy'), asks Claude to rank which services are likely to fail next and why, and opens a preventive ClickUp task before anything breaks — for high-risk predictions it also sends an immediate alert. It then closes the loop: after the predicted risk window elapses, it checks whether the incident actually happened and whether the preventive task was completed, so prediction accuracy is tracked, not just asserted.

### How to set up
1. Import this workflow into n8n
2. Add credentials: incident log/PagerDuty-style API, deployment platform API, APM/metrics API, log aggregator API, GitHub API (or your code-churn source), Anthropic API (header auth, x-api-key), ClickUp API, WhatsApp Business Cloud API on every WhatsApp node
3. Edit Set - Config: clickupListId, historicalWindowDays, defaultVerificationWindowDays, highRiskThreshold, mediumRiskThreshold, and every API URL
4. Activate the workflow, or use the Manual Trigger to test end to end

### Requirements
- Historical incident log API access
- Deployment history API access
- APM/metrics trend API access
- Log aggregator API access (error volume over time)
- GitHub API access (commit/PR churn) or equivalent code-change source
- Anthropic API access (Claude)
- ClickUp API access (tasks)
- WhatsApp Business Cloud API credentials

### How to customize
- Add more risk signals (on-call load, dependency freshness, test coverage trend) to the risk-profiling code node
- Adjust highRiskThreshold/mediumRiskThreshold to change how aggressively preventive tasks get created
- Tune the recurring-pattern detection logic (currently day-of-week and post-deploy proximity) to match your org's actual failure history
- Feed the outcome log from the verification loop back into future prompts so Claude's predictions calibrate over time

## 1. Trigger & Historical Data Collection

Set - Config centralizes the service list, historical/verification windows, and every API URL.

Five parallel HTTP Request nodes pull the raw history for the historical window:
- HTTP Request - Fetch Historical Incident Log
- HTTP Request - Fetch Deployment History
- HTTP Request - Fetch Metrics Trend Data
- HTTP Request - Fetch Error Log Volume Trend
- HTTP Request - Fetch Code Change Activity

Merge - Combine All Historical Sources joins all five into one item so the risk-profiling code node sees the full history at once.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Risk Profiling & AI Prediction

parameters.content:
## 2. Per-Service Risk Profiling & Prediction

JS - Build Per-Service Risk Profiles & Detect Recurring Patterns is the first code node: for every service it computes incident frequency, days since last incident, deployment failure rate, metric-trend slope, error-log volume trend, and a code-churn score, then looks for recurring patterns — clustering incidents by weekday and checking how often incidents follow a deployment within 24-48 hours.

HTTP Request - Claude: Predict Services Likely to Fail sends every service's profile and the detected patterns and asks for a ranked list: failure probability, predicted failure mode, contributing factors, recommended preventive actions, and a predicted risk window in days. JS - Parse Failure Predictions parses that safely and fans out into one item per service worth reporting.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Prediction Routing & Task Creation

parameters.content:
## 3. Risk-Based Routing & Preventive Task Creation

Switch - Route By Risk Level splits predictions three ways:
- High risk: WhatsApp - Send Urgent Risk Alert fires immediately, then HTTP Request - Create Urgent Preventive Task opens a high-priority ClickUp task.
- Medium risk: HTTP Request - Create Standard Preventive Task opens a normal-priority ClickUp task, no immediate page.
- Low risk: Set - Logged Only (No Action) — not every elevated probability needs a task; low-confidence predictions are just recorded.

Both task-creation branches converge into the verification loop below.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Prediction Outcome Verification Loop

parameters.content:
## 4. Prediction Outcome Verification (calibration loop)

JS - Attach Task Id to Prediction Record carries the created ClickUp task id forward. Wait - For Prediction Verification Window is a genuine TIME-based wait, sized to the predicted risk window (falls back to defaultVerificationWindowDays).

After the wait: HTTP Request - Re-Fetch Incident Log For Service checks whether the predicted service actually had an incident, and HTTP Request - Fetch Preventive Task Status checks whether the task was completed in time.

IF - Incident Occurred During Window:
- Yes: WhatsApp - Alert Prediction Confirmed (Incident Occurred) — the prediction was right; worth a postmortem note on whether the preventive task was actioned in time.
- No: IF - Preventive Task Completed decides between WhatsApp - Send Prevention Success Summary (task done, no incident — likely prevented) or Set - Case Status No Incident Task Pending (no incident yet, but nothing to alert on either).
